verdict.rationale: Google's docs claim only that codes are encrypted "in transit and at rest," which is not end-to-end encryption with a key the vendor never holds. No encryption design document appears in the evidence. A community member notes that Authenticator's cloud sync lacks the end-to-end encryption Android backups get, which is consistent with the absence of this capability rather than a dispute over a vendor claim.

support.subject: As a security engineer, backups are end-to-end encrypted with a key the vendor never holds, and the encryption design is documented
